centralMetadataChanges.change: Remove re-save without permission metadata claim. Unencrypted files are already password-free; encrypted files are actually rendered after PDF.js accepts the password. Disclose loss of selectable text, links, forms and digital signatures and 25 MB/100-page/2000-point limits.
Replace obsolete nine-anchor/pixel-offset claim with click-to-place PDF-point coordinates. Explain that replacement and removal add white overlays and leave original content recoverable.

Qualify faithful-copy statement: DCT JPEG bytes preserved; supported 8-bit raster samples reconstructed with supported grayscale soft masks; CMYK conversion approximate; predictors, decode transforms, color-key masks and unsupported codecs are skipped.

Document 25 MB input, 100 pages and 2000-point page side limits. Merge has 20-file/100-total-page limit; add-pages has 20 insert files/100 source pages/100 final pages; extraction has 16M pixels per image/32M cumulative image pixels.

remainingBlockers: Latest complete Chrome run: 1 passed, 10 failed; 6 functional cases not run. It predates watermark Clear and file-backed oversized upload fixes. Subsequent extraction/watermark retry: both failed hydration before functional checks.

Latest complete WebKit run: 0 passed, 11 failed; all functional cases not run. Navigation CSP fetch timeouts and hydration timeouts retained. Earlier WebKit run recorded Unexpected EOF in Next.js page/layout chunks.

Initial Chrome run recorded five functional passes (add-pages, annotate, edit, merge, password-remover) but all failed runtime checks due to backend CORS. Do not equate functional passes with overall acceptance.

Shared subscription/API-status fetches to https://api.toolblip.com/api/plans and /api/tools failed CORS from localhost. Direct API probe timed out after 15 seconds; localhost /api/plans returned 404. Classified as environment/backend dependency observations; not suppressed in harness.

Multiple simultaneous browser groups and TypeScript processes observed. Directly fetched page chunk was 38364987 bytes and parsed successfully, including 1074 embedded modules, despite browser chunk syntax/hydration failures. Root cause of delivery/runtime failure remains unresolved.

Component fixes for extraction soft-mask Decode and watermark pending-read Clear still need successful integrated browser verification. Parent must stabilize local server/runtime before rerunning failures; no server restart/build performed here.
capabilityLimits: Unlock flattens encrypted pages into images, not editable vector/text objects; no password guessing.
Annotation marks are drawn into page content, not editable comment objects.
Sign adds a visual image, not a cryptographic signature.
Edit white covers are not secure redaction.
Extraction explicitly skips unsupported encodings/transforms/masks and approximates DeviceCMYK colors.
Fixtures cover unrotated overlay source pages and explicit rearrange rotation. Cropped and pre-rotated overlay preview alignment has not been browser-verified.
integrationFixes: Moved pdf-fixtures.mjs from cases to helpers; updated imports and report paths. Strict loader array validation unchanged.
Paired download event and button click in Promise.all so timeouts are reported without unhandled rejection terminating the group.
Upload the unchanged 26 MB oversized fixture from an artifact file to avoid serializing its bytes through the browser protocol.

ExtractImgClient accepts explicit identity soft-mask Decode [0 1]; unsupported transforms, predictors and Matte remain rejected. Independent RGB/alpha checks unchanged; fixture unit tests now assert identity Decode.
AddWatermarkToPDFClient enables Clear during loading so its existing version invalidation can cancel a pending read.
Browser harness requires React properties on tool descendants; script download alone no longer proves hydration. Regression failed before fix and passed after.
Development CSP routing retains original fetch errors, aborts the failed navigation and records failed cases instead of crashing the process. Regression failed before fix and passed after.
